comment: A coordination capability can confirm that a handoff happened without revealing the clinical content — carrying the event and its state, not the record. This is a concrete form of the draft's own minimisation and privacy-by-design, and removes a class of consent risk. We recommend naming metadata-/attestation-only coordination as a reference privacy pattern.

reviewer.organisation: CoWEAVE - Medtronic LABS; eGov Foundation; Open Healthcare Network Foundation

public.text: A coordination capability can confirm that a handoff happened without revealing the clinical content — carrying the event and its state, not the record. This is a concrete form of the draft's own minimisation and privacy-by-design, and removes a class of consent risk. We recommend naming metadata-/attestation-only coordination as a reference privacy pattern.
